messages:
Marta V (PM): Heads-up: execs want a crisp launch checklist by EOD. We need to lock MVP vs v1 and call out non-negotiable acceptance criteria for the launch.

Ethan J (Eng): Can we list the core SLOs first? My vote: 95th pct latency < 200ms for pilot tenants, error rate < 0.5%. Anything else?

Ritu P (Eng-ML): Also add output consistency guards for model upgrades (prompt regression tests). If we don't gate model swaps we risk rollout flakiness.

Noah K (SRE): Ops items: deploy rollback playbook, monitoring alerts, capacity headroom for canaries. Without a rollback we can't guarantee SLA.

Carla S (Sales): Customers asked explicitly for per-tenant model pinning and a way to opt into a pilot. If that isn't in MVP, we lose demos.

Marta V (PM): Proposal: MVP must include routing + per-tenant pinning + basic observability (latency/error charts). Everything else goes to v1. We'll include a lightweight response cache for pilot tenants only to stabilize demo latency.

Ethan J (Eng): Agrees on per-tenant pilot cache, but we should avoid a global embeddings cache in MVP. That is infra-heavy. We can mark it v1.

Ritu P (Eng-ML): For the regression tests, I'll produce a 50-sample prompt set and expected output fingerprints. We can run them on every model pin change. That fits MVP if we scope to the demo models.

Noah K (SRE): I'll document the rollback steps and prewire an alert for token-generation spikes. Also recommend a canary window of 10 minutes with synthetic traffic.

Carla S (Sales): I'll prep pilot customer consent language: "pilot features prioritized for demo tenants; capacity limited." Need this copy for legal.

Marta V (PM): Decision summary (MVP): routing + tenant pinning + basic telemetry + pilot-scoped response cache + model regression harness for pinned models. v1: global embeddings cache, quantized batched path, broader rollout gating.

Ethan J (Eng): Action items:
- Ethan: implement pilot response cache toggle (demo-only) -> 3d
- Ritu: deliver regression harness + sample prompts -> 2d
- Noah: rollback doc + canary automation -> 2d
- Carla: customer pilot language + sales brief -> 1d
- Marta: file v1 backlog and update launch checklist -> today

Marta V (PM): One more constraint: we should not add new infra migrations in the release window. That means quantization and cache migrations must be in v1. Confirming no infra migrations in MVP.

Ethan J (Eng): Confirmed. We'll keep code changes confined to toggles and pilot-scoped code paths.

Ritu P (Eng-ML): I'll add a note in the harness that any model pin that changes more than X% of outputs fails auto-approve. Fine?

Noah K (SRE): Fine. Also tagging: @oncall for the deploy window.

release-bot: Reminder: release freeze 2024-05-10T16:00 UTC.

Marta V (PM): Great. I'll circulate the checklist and close the decision. We'll reconvene tomorrow for a short status check. :heavy_check_mark:

Carla S (Sales): :thumbsup:

Ethan J (Eng): will start spike now.
